Type: scrolled metal console table
Use: entry or behind-sofa surface for decor and lamps; living room, hallway
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: dark oak-look wood top, black wrought metal base
Colors: dark grey oak, black
Shape: long narrow rectangular top with clipped corners, ornate scrollwork apron, curved cabriole-style legs with curled feet, low stretcher with finial, slim and decorative
Feel: ornate, old-world, elegant
Goes with: dark wood, warm neutral walls, mirrors, iron accents; traditional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Ravenna Home Wood and Metal End Table, 44"W, Dark Oak, Black Metal
product.description: 44.0"W x 12.0"D x 31.5"H Made with select hardwood, flat-cut oak veneers, and metal Deep hues and mixed-material construction make this chic table a must-have. Intricate metal curls and curves define this attractive console table both above and below. Openwork details highlight the edge of a sturdy brown wooden top in a slender 12"-deep profile. No assembly required
